// @path: src/lib/ops/operationsHelper.ts
// @expect: OPS-PRISMA-IMPORT
// A fifth module reaching for the client, with a name close enough to the
// fourth to look like it belongs. Four modules may import Prisma and they are
// named one by one: the read chokepoint, the audit writer, the door, and the
// operations module. "It is basically part of operations.ts" is how a
// chokepoint stops being one.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function subject(parentId) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({ where: { id: parentId }, select: { id: true } });
}
